# MetaOnticVideo

> MetaOnticVideo (`dsh-metaontic-video`) is an AI video creation plugin for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app. It helps beginners create short videos and offers a segmented continuation workflow for longer videos.

## What it does

- Turns a user's video idea into a script and storyboard draft, then supports review before video production.
- Uses the text, image, and video models configured in the plugin settings for those respective generation tasks. The Harness session model remains responsible for ordinary chat and tool orchestration.
- Supports text-to-video, image-to-video, segmented continuation, pausing and resuming, segment previews, and local merging.
- A long video is produced through multiple model calls; it is not generated as one uninterrupted long clip. Local merging of multiple segments requires FFmpeg and FFprobe.
- Windows and macOS use the same plugin package.

## Setup

1. In DeepSeek Harness, open Plugins → Add plugin and enter `dsh-metaontic-video`. Harness prioritizes the China mirror for users in mainland China.
2. In plugin settings, configure the API key and the text, image, and video model IDs supported by the selected channel.
3. Open the Video Creation Assistant, describe the project, review the script, and confirm video production when ready.

The read-only model list in settings shows models visible to the configured API key; visibility does not guarantee that a model supports chat completions. Script calls use the configured text model and are billed by the provider's actual usage without a separate approval prompt. Video production keeps its own review and cost confirmation.
